schools.source: Existing game school-calendar.ts: common K–5, grades 6–8, grades 9–12 and a shared fall calendar. NCES CCD local-institutions.json supplies recent district/high-school identities, not historical attendance or historical existence. school-names.ts supplies generated landscape naming forms.

work.label: Opening job tenure
work.source: Existing generated work:opening start from town-employment.ts. Its opening tenure is derived from BLS Employee Tenure in January 2026 age-cohort medians and bounded by the person's working-age start. Preserve that source date; no reconstructed historical earnings or employer balance.

preservedFields.gap: No dated prior family record was supplied; current kinship alone does not date earlier events.
No dated prior partnership record was supplied; a current partner link does not establish a wedding date or legal marriage.
Prior moves and addresses require a dated personal record; population mover rates do not choose an individual's history.
No personal loss record was supplied; cohort mortality or a public disaster does not establish a relative's death.
No personal faith or congregation record was supplied; family identity and local religious shares do not establish personal belief.
Opening cash and current pay do not establish older balances, income, taxes, debt, or prior employer funds.
No prior personal view record was supplied; living through an era does not establish a belief, vote, feeling, or quotation.
